captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a pair of marine 7x50 porro-prism binoculars. It features two asymmetrical tapered barrels finished in a dark, rubberized matte black housing, complete with blue-tinted glass lenses at both the objective and eyepiece ends. The two main barrels are connected to a central bridge assembly featuring a central revolute hinge, a cylindrical focus wheel, and a diopter adjustment ring on one of the eyepieces.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a pair of marine 7x50 porro-prism binoculars with a dark rubberized housing. The assembly should include two distinct left and right barrels connected by a central hinge, complete with blue glass lenses, a central focusing knob, and a diopter ring on the eyepiece.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by defining a central hinge structure using cylindrical and box primitives. Each barrel is modeled as a compound shape composed of offset cylinders of varying radii to create the tapered porro-prism profile. Lenses are created as thin cylinders and embedded into the ends of the barrels using boolean operations or precise positioning. A central focusing wheel is added along the hinge axis using a ribbed or plain cylinder, and a diopter adjustment ring is modeled as an additional collar on the right eyepiece.
